scripts.plan: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 bun alchemy plan alchemy.run.ts --stage dev --adopt --detailed
scripts.deploy: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 bun alchemy deploy alchemy.run.ts --stage dev --adopt
scripts.drift: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 bun alchemy drift --config alchemy.run.ts --stage dev
scripts.destroy: DO_NOT_TRACK=1 ALCHEMY_PROBE_TEARDOWN=1 bun alchemy destroy alchemy.run.ts --stage dev
